points.K1: 合成纤维扁平吊带的颜色代码

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着安全帽，手里拿着一条彩色吊带招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot in a hard hat holds a colorful flat lifting sling and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天两道面试题：吊带颜色和载荷。
overlay: 扁平吊带的颜色代码与安全工作载荷

shots.scene: 阿杰站在仓库里，面前挂着一排不同颜色的吊带
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands in a warehouse in front of a rack of flat slings in many colors.
shots.narration: 阿杰发现，吊带有好多种颜色。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头看着吊带
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head looking at the colorful slings.
shots.narration: 颜色不同，到底有什么讲究？

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一张空白颜色表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank chart with colored rows.
shots.narration: 看这张表就明白了，记得截图保存。

shots.section_title: 合成纤维扁平吊带的颜色代码
shots.scene: 一排不同颜色的扁平吊带并排
shots.prompt_en: A row of flat lifting slings in solid colors: violet, green, yellow, grey, red, brown, blue and orange. No people.
shots.narration: 合成纤维扁平吊带，用颜色区分吨数。
overlay: 合成纤维扁平吊带的颜色代码

shots.section_title: 合成纤维扁平吊带的颜色代码
shots.scene: 紫色吊带旁一个砝码
shots.prompt_en: A violet sling with one small weight icon beside it. No people.

shots.section_title: 合成纤维扁平吊带的颜色代码
shots.scene: 绿色吊带旁两个砝码
shots.prompt_en: A green sling with two small weight icons beside it. No people.

shots.section_title: 合成纤维扁平吊带的颜色代码
shots.scene: 黄色吊带旁三个砝码
shots.prompt_en: A yellow sling with three small weight icons beside it. No people.

shots.section_title: 合成纤维扁平吊带的颜色代码
shots.scene: 灰色和红色吊带旁的砝码
shots.prompt_en: A grey sling with four weight icons and a red sling with five weight icons. No people.

shots.section_title: 合成纤维扁平吊带的颜色代码
shots.scene: 棕色和蓝色吊带旁的砝码
shots.prompt_en: A brown sling with six weight icons and a blue sling with eight weight icons. No people.

shots.section_title: 合成纤维扁平吊带的颜色代码
shots.scene: 两条橙色吊带旁的大砝码
shots.prompt_en: Two orange slings each with a large weight icon beside them. No people.

shots.section_title: 合成纤维扁平吊带的颜色代码
shots.scene: 完整颜色表，八行依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The full color chart with eight rows lighting up one after another. No people.

shots.scene: 吊车钩挂着吊带吊起箱子，旁边一个砝码上限线
shots.prompt_en: A crane hook lifts a crate with a flat sling, a weight icon beside it under a red limit line. No people.
shots.narration: SWL，安全工作载荷：允许吊的最大重量。

shots.scene: 超重的箱子被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An oversized crate on a sling, with its weight icon above the limit line, crossed out with a red X. No people.

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起三根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up three fingers next to a yellow sling.
shots.narration: 怎样知道吊带的SWL？有三种方法。

shots.scene: 黄色吊带和颜色表并排，黄色一行被圈出
shots.prompt_en: A yellow sling next to the color chart, with the yellow row circled. No people.
shots.narration: 第一，看颜色，对照颜色表。

shots.scene: 放大镜照着吊带上的蓝色空白标签
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a blank blue tag sewn onto the yellow sling. No people.

shots.scene: 标签上出现一个砝码图标
shots.prompt_en: A weight icon appears on the blank blue tag. No people.

shots.scene: 吊带表面的黑色竖条纹逐条亮起
shots.prompt_en: Black stripes woven along the yellow sling light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 第三，数吊带表面的黑色条纹。

shots.scene: 一条条纹旁出现一个砝码
shots.prompt_en: One black stripe glows with one weight icon beside it. No people.

shots.scene: 三条条纹旁出现三个砝码
shots.prompt_en: Three black stripes glow with three weight icons beside them. No people.

shots.scene: 老李看了看吊带，挂上3吨的箱子
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the yellow sling and hooks it to a crate with a weight icon of three.
shots.narration: 黄色、标签、三条纹，都是3吨。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现八色吊带
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating slings in eight colors.
shots.narration: 颜色代表吨数，从紫1到橙10。

shots.scene: 砝码和红色上限线
shots.prompt_en: A weight icon under a red limit line. No people.
shots.narration: 起吊重量不超过安全工作载荷。

shots.scene: 颜色、标签、条纹三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a color swatch, a tag and striped webbing. No people.

shots.scene: 欣欣把吊带挂回架子，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot hangs the sling back on the rack and waves goodbye.
